method: Count recognized ROBOT violation headers; classify primary IRI and axiom actor without treating multiline annotation text as separate violations.

priority_units.remedy: Declare intended CAC entities with the narrowest evidence-supported entity kind.
Replace obsolete or invalid external terms with verified pinned-version vocabulary.
Adopt a supported datatype representation without silently changing value meaning.
Move planning durations out of the OWL DL semantic layer or adopt a supported representation.
Add a bounded SKOS vocabulary/import strategy for shared controlled concepts.
Add a bounded annotation vocabulary/declaration strategy for first-party metadata.
Treat upstream embedded shapes separately or obtain an upstream/profile correction.
Preserve as upstream evidence and avoid silently patching pinned bytes.
Separate object and datatype property meanings; preserve compatibility explicitly.
